newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 3.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday.
-- Government may stop or scale down public works spending funded by revenue from the sales of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) shares.
-- Toray Industries Inc plans to start synthetic fibre business in Czech Republic by investing about ten billion yen. It aims to start production as early as 1999.
